decls.name: PrimesOneModThreeLogSum

paper_span.quote: congruent to \(1 \bmod 3\), the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions [Dav00] gives

decls.rationale: Fact 3.10: the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions gives \(\sum_{i \le \ell} \log r_i = O(\ell\log\ell)\) for the first \(\ell\) primes \(\equiv 1 \pmod 3\).
